title: Herb Crusted Veal Cutlets
description: Tender veal cutlets coated in a fragrant herb crust, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the veal cutlets with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix together the herbs and Greek yogurt.
Coat each veal cutlet with the herb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the coated veal cutlets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the cutlets to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
